DIAGNOSIS READY: Bed Bug Bite Reaction (Papular Urticaria)

The clinical picture of linear "breakfast of champions" papules on exposed areas following travel, combined with the absence of systemic symptoms and a negative scabies workup, confirms an insect bite reaction rather than an infectious etiology. No further tests or images are required at this time.
